equity.level_reason: Mammography percentages by three family-income groups are reported and described as increasing with income, but no difference or ratio is computed and no disparity framing is given.

level_alternative.reason: Income is a social determinant and the stratifier; the gradient 67.7% to 81.5% could be read as a quantified contrast across an SDOH exposure.

equity.equity_measurement: Income as % of FPL in three groups; missing family income imputed.
